name: JPMorgan Chase & Co.
blurb: JPMorgan Chase & Co. is a leading global financial services firm and one of the largest banking institutions in the United States. It operates through four major segments: Consumer & Community Banking, Corporate & Investment Bank, Commercial Banking, and Asset & Wealth Management. The company provides a wide range of services including investment banking, financial transaction processing, asset management, and retail banking. As of 2025, it is the largest bank in the U.S. by assets and a component of the Dow Jones Industrial Average.
recent: In the past 30 days, JPMorgan Chase's stock has shown positive momentum, driven by strong quarterly earnings and favorable interest rate expectations. The company reported better-than-expected revenue and profit, benefiting from higher net interest income and robust investment banking fees. Analysts have raised price targets, citing the bank's diversified business model and capital strength.
